reasoning: Both attempts work and pass the static checks, and both have accessible step-button volume controls. A follows the player's Roblox settings: it watches PreferredTransparency and ReducedMotionEnabled live and applies them. B never reads either setting. A's confirmation buttons are named by outcome ('Keep blocks'/'Delete blocks'); B's are Cancel/Delete. Both share the same B-button gap: B closes the whole menu instead of backing out of the dialog first. A wins.
